label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Cuando hurta varón buey o cordero, y lo degüella o lo vende, cinco ganado pagará debajo del buey, y cuatro rebaño debajo del cordero.
spanish: Cuando hurta varón buey o animal del rebaño, y lo degüella o lo ha vendido, cinco reses pagará en lugar del buey, y cuatro cabezas de rebaño en lugar del animal del rebaño.
grammarChanges: cordero -> animal del rebaño (both occurrences): שֶׂה is one animal from the flock, sheep or goat; cordero narrowed it to a young sheep.
debajo -> en lugar de (both occurrences): תַּחַת beside the repayment verb carries the instead-of sense, not only the spatial under sense.
ganado -> reses: בָּקָר is the bovine herd specifically; ganado could read as livestock generally.
cuatro rebaño -> cuatro cabezas de rebaño: Spanish numeral agreement requires a countable classifier with the collective noun rebaño.
vende -> ha vendido: distinguishes the plain perfect מְכָרוֹ from the sequential perfect degüella, which were leveled to the same present tense.
readerNote: Added the classifier "cabezas de" so "cuatro ... rebaño" agrees in number, and rendered the plain perfect מְכָרוֹ as "ha vendido" to keep it distinct from the sequential "degüella".
